name: K8bas Skyblock Utility
description: A modular client-side toolkit for Hypixel SkyBlock: rule-based outlines for the mobs and NPCs you can see, island-aware waypoints with beacon beams for NPCs at fixed spots, a searchable settings screen with mob and NPC lists that stays sharp at every GUI scale, and updates from GitHub that install when you quit, after you confirm them. For mining: a Glacite Mineshaft entry alert with your corpse keys, possible corpse spots and an Organ Donor ding hint. For fishing: hotspot rings with a warning when yours disappears, and a bobber that floats smoothly. For the bestiary: a HUD panel with your kills, tiers and kills per hour. Display only: no gameplay automation, and no packet is cancelled or changed. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Hypixel.
